IONQ.summary: IonQ is getting a ton of attention online right now, and it's not hard to see why. Over the past 24 hours, Reddit mentions of IONQ jumped from just 1 to 20, putting it at rank 27 among all stocks discussed. On Stocktwits, the mood is overwhelmingly bullish, with 21 bullish tags versus only 2 bearish ones. The main catalyst is a real technical breakthrough: IonQ announced it successfully demonstrated the first end-to-end real-time quantum error correction decoder that runs on a standard CPU. This was validated across benchmark circuits simulating up to 408 logical qubits and more than 31.5 million operations. For those who don't follow quantum computing closely, error correction is a huge deal because quantum computers are notoriously error-prone. If IonQ can correct errors in real time on regular hardware, that's a major step toward fault-tolerant quantum systems, which many see as the holy grail for making quantum computers commercially useful. The community is extremely excited, with messages like 'Congrats bulls! Amazing news today as we get closer to the era of fault-tolerant quantum systems' and 'The catalyst is a real technical breakthrough announcement.' Some are making bold price predictions, like '$50 is given for Wednesday' and '$800 incoming,' while others are loading up on call options expecting a big move. There's also a lot of trash talk toward short sellers, with one user saying 'bears need to go back into their cave' and another warning 'Shorts you're about to get spanked.' The enthusiasm is spilling over into other quantum stocks like QBTS and RGTI, which are also mentioned as likely to rocket. However, it's important to keep things in perspective. Quantum computing is still a very early-stage industry, and IonQ is not yet profitable. The stock is highly volatile and prone to hype cycles. While the technical milestone is impressive, it may take years before it translates into meaningful revenue. Investors should also note that the broader market is in rally mode, which can amplify gains but also lead to sharp reversals. The extreme bullish sentiment on Stocktwits and Reddit can sometimes be a contrarian indicator, especially when price targets like $800 are thrown around. That said, if IonQ continues to deliver on its technology roadmap, it could be a long-term winner. For now, the community is laser-focused on the error correction news and expects a big move upward. As always, do your own research and consider the risks before jumping in.
